title: Qiskit/OpenQASM assurance bridge iSWAP verifier hardening

change_under_test.mechanism: Add iSWAP to the verifier supported-gate declaration. The dense simulator already implemented the iSWAP unitary.

verdicts.coverage_gate: Pass only when coverage is at least 95 percent and every safety gate passes.
verdicts.full_release_gate: Pass only when the coverage, safety, determinism, and original adapter-overhead gates all pass.

limitations: The original v0.1 result remains unchanged and authoritative for the baseline run.
This rerun does not contain simulator, emulator, provider, or QPU execution evidence.
Qiskit level-3 measurements remain descriptive and do not establish superiority.
Operator equivalence up to global phase does not authorize controlled-subcircuit promotion.
